scope: QA independente pós-coleta dos 16 JSONs e logs; sem Godot/build. Integridade numérica não implica ausência de defeitos do jogo nem validade causal de rodada com erro. Foco é flag na borda da amostra, não observação contínua entre callbacks.
quantile_definition: sort ascending; p50=floor(n/2), p95=floor(n*.95), p99=floor(n*.99), clamped n-1; matches runner exactly, no interpolation
phase_reconstruction: frame_ms = pre_process_gap_ms + physics_callback_ms + process_callback_ms + process_to_deferred_ms + deferred_to_render_pre_ms + render_bracket_ms; physics sum from nonoverlapping tick callback timestamps
units: frame/bracket/GPU/CPU ms; telemetry counters usec; physics_steps counts. TIME_PROCESS/TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS are retained raw latest monitors and excluded from summary averages. GPU/viewport CPU samples asynchronous.
comparability_notes: session_profile0_1 has two runtime errors and instrumentation0_2 has one despite exit0 and invalid[]; exclude both from causal comparisons.

session_profile0_2 is the only error-free repeat of the session-profiler-off control, but only 14.115% of measured frame endpoints were focused. Neither session-profiler-off run supplies an equivalent fully focused 30s observation; do not claim this control causally clean.

Focus losses: no_traffic_yield_1 about 1.736% measured frame endpoints, no_traffic_yield_2 and session_profile0_1 100% unfocused, session_profile0_2 about 85.885% unfocused. Fractions are included per phase; error-free and focused are distinct criteria.

Profiler/body and session counters describe measured callback bodies; dispatch, per-source tracing, retained dictionaries and writer/native costs are not fully included. Do not subtract them to invent uninstrumented FPS.
Native memory growth includes retained raw dictionaries, arrays and spans plus world/cache changes. No no-retention control was run; observed growth is not proof of a product leak.

Sources were snapshotted before each run and are identical across 16 runs including compiled DLL. This does not prove no transient disk changes occurred between snapshots. Production instrumentation was restored afterward; current production hashes are intentionally different from measurement sources.
